name: Lake Greenwood training reach
description: A schematic, playable training reach inspired by Lake Greenwood, South Carolina. Shorelines and islands are not surveyed or geographically exact.
source_note: The South Carolina Department of Natural Resources describes Lake Greenwood as a long, narrow reservoir of roughly 11,400 acres. This polygon is original prototype art, not an SCDNR map or USGS shoreline.
coordinate_system: local metres; +x east, +y north; heading/from_deg clockwise from north
